h1: Plywood exporter to the Maldives: marine, BWR and Okoume-faced panels from Kochi
lede: Island work is bought by sea and used in humidity, so the bond matters more here than on a dry inland job. We press IS 710 BWP marine plywood, BWR board and calibrated Okoume-faced panels in Perumbavoor, Kerala, 40 km from Cochin Port, and quote FOB Cochin in USD.
tldr: In short: Cochin Wood Industries is a plywood manufacturer in Kerala, India, shipping to the Maldives on a short sea lane. IS 710 BWP marine plywood for boat work and wet areas, BWR for interiors, calibrated Okoume-faced panels for fit-out, film-faced ply for formwork. USD quotes, FOB Cochin, replies within one business day.
faq: What HS code does plywood ship under to the Maldives?

Heading 4412. The item within 4412.31, 4412.33, 4412.34 and 4412.39 turns on panel construction and individual ply thickness as well as face species, and finished cases, pallets and drums are generally considered under 4415. We state the code we ship under on the commercial invoice; your broker confirms the national line.
Which grade should I specify for a resort or jetty project?

Exposure decides it, not budget. IS 710 BWP marine plywood for boat work, jetties and wet areas; BWR for interiors and joinery that will meet moisture; MR-bonded packing plywood only for dry, one-trip use. MR is not a wet-service grade and no coating turns it into one.
Which port in the Maldives do you ship to?

The one you nominate. We sell FOB Cochin, so your forwarder books the ocean carriage and names the discharge port, and onward handling to an island site is arranged by you. Tell us the port at enquiry and it goes on the proforma invoice.
What are your payment terms for buyers in the Maldives?
50% advance with the order and the balance before dispatch for standard products; 100% advance for custom specifications. Payment is by bank transfer (T/T), and quotes are in USD.
cta_p: Send thickness, sheet size, grade and quantity, and tell us where the panels will be used. A USD FOB Cochin quotation comes back within one business day. sales@cochinwood.in — +91 95674 10175.
